facts.business: UTL Industries Limited is engaged in providing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO) services, undertaking commercial projects, solar power distribution, and residential, commercial and industrial construction services.
key_risks: Revenue recognition for construction contracts involves significant accounting judgements including estimation of costs to complete, determining stage of completion and timing of revenue recognition
Revenue recognition and measurement of contract assets in respect of un-invoiced amounts and measurement of receivables in respect of overdue invoices
